units.source_text: 源氏公子心事重重，方寸缭乱。

en.t: Prince Genji was weighed down with worries, and his heart was in turmoil.

units.source_text: 久不赴左大臣邸宅，葵姬自然满怀怨恨。

en.t: Since he had not gone to the Minister of the Left's residence for a long time, Lady Aoi was naturally filled with resentment.

units.source_text: 那六条妃子呢，起初拒绝公子求爱，好容易被他说服；

en.t: As for the Rokujō lady, she had at first refused the prince's courtship, and only with difficulty had he persuaded her;

units.source_text: 岂知说服之后，公子的态度忽然一变，对她疏远了。

en.t: but after winning her over, the prince's manner suddenly changed, and he became distant toward her.
How deeply the Rokujō lady was hurt!

units.source_text: 她现在常常考虑：未曾发生关系以前他那种一往情深的热爱，如今何以没有了呢？

en.t: Now she often wondered: why had the ardent devotion he showed before they became intimate disappeared?

units.source_text: 这妃子是个深思远虑、洞察事理的人。

en.t: This lady was thoughtful, far-sighted, and keenly perceptive.

units.source_text: 她想起两人年龄太不相称[\[11\]](#part1333.html#m11)，深恐世人谣传，

en.t: When she thought of how ill-matched their ages were[\[11\]](#part1333.html#m11), she deeply feared the gossip of the world,

units.source_text: 两人为此疏远，更觉痛心。

en.t: and if that was why the two of them had grown distant, it pained her all the more.

units.source_text: 每当源氏公子不来、孤衾独寝之时，总是左思右想，悲愤叹息，不能成眠。

en.t: Whenever Prince Genji did not come and she slept alone, she would turn things over in her mind, sighing in grief and bitterness, unable to fall asleep.
